title: NYSE’s owner is backing 24/7 stock tokens without Wall Street’s usual price rules
summary: The company that owns the New York Stock Exchange wants people to be able to buy stocks 24/7. Given the trading volume crypto and other tokenized assets have seen in the past year or so, the decision to introduce stock tokens comes as no surprise.
